query:
ALTER TABLE doc_sequences ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recipient_name VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER document_title;
UPDATE doc_sequences SET recipient_name = TRIM(REPLACE(document_title, 'PKWT - ', '')) WHERE document_type = 'PKWT' AND document_title LIKE 'PKWT - %'
